tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Zoe wants to talk about new school clothes. which colour to choose. what size to get. where to shop.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Zoe.

promptBlocks.subject: What should I wear?
paragraphs: I am writing about new school clothes. which colour to choose? what size to get?
where to shop? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Zoe and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: new school clothes
ketImageBrief.panel1: Zoe starts new school clothes with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Zoe solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
